Evidence:
[1] He also voiced Athrun Zala from "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED", Hikaru Shindo from "Hikaru no Go", Julian Star from "Cardcaptors", and Tieria Erde from "Mobile Suit Gundam 00".
[2] Athrun Zala (アスラン・ザラ , Asuran Zara ) is a fictional character from the Japanese science fiction anime television series "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED" and its sequel "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny", part of the Gundam franchise.
[3] Samuel Vincent Khouth is a Canadian voice actor who works in Vancouver and voices characters in animated series, anime dubs and video games.
[4] He is voiced in Japanese by Akira Ishida and in English by Samuel Vincent in the Ocean dub and by Chris Hackney in the NYAV dub.

Notes:
[bridge] Samuel Vincent voiced Athrun Zala in the English dub of Gundam SEED, but the Japanese voice actor is Akira Ishida.
